Studio photo uses U²-Netp, a small salient-object model, to remove
backgrounds on the phone. No photo is sent to a paid API.

Model: U²-Netp
Paper: Qin, Xuebin et al., "U2-Net: Going Deeper with Nested U-Structure
       for Salient Object Detection," Pattern Recognition, 2020.
Source: https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net
License: Apache License 2.0 (see U2-Net-LICENSE.txt)
ONNX weights: the u2netp.onnx file published with rembg
  https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg  (MIT)
  SHA-256: 309c8469258dda742793dce0ebea8e6dd393174f89934733ecc8b14c76f4ddd8
  Size: 4,574,861 bytes (~4.36 MiB)
Input: 320×320 RGB, ImageNet normalization.

Runtime: onnxruntime-web (Microsoft, MIT), lazy-loaded from jsDelivr
  and cached by the browser after the first use.

These files are not precached by the service worker. They load only
when someone taps “Make it look pro.”
